definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.ServiceFeeMaximum

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.SettlementBacking
definitions.meaning: backingを保存し、escrow・feeReserve・未決済債務へ規定差分を適用

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.SigningCycleReserve
definitions.meaning: 請求後もreserveを残す

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalAdmissionBoundary
definitions.meaning: minimumは非0でobservedはminimum以上

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalFinalityQuorum
definitions.meaning: 二者が高さをattestし、identity版は高さとhashの二者一致

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.ClaimContracts.WithdrawalFinalization
definitions.meaning: notifyには成功かつfinalized以下かつcanonicalが必要、finalized不在ならretry

definitions.meaning: ID一意性・集計一致・backing・予約のrecord種別だけを拘束する

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.GlobalHistory.Backed
definitions.meaning: escrow=baseSupply+feeReserve+unmintedLiability+unreleasedLiability

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.GlobalHistory.eventDelta

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.AdmissibleUntilOccurs
definitions.meaning: 対象終端イベントが選択まで常時受理可能であるという仮定

definitions.meaning: readyAt以降の継続的な可用性とweak fairnessをまとめた仮定

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.ExpiredDepositEventuallyRefunded
definitions.meaning: 対象depositがrefundedへ到達

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.FundedDepositEventuallyMinted
definitions.meaning: 対象depositがmintedへ到達

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.FundingFailureEventuallyCancelled
definitions.meaning: 対象depositがcancelledへ到達

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.WeakFair
definitions.meaning: 継続的に有効な具体イベントが将来選択されるという仮定

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.Liveness.WithdrawalEventuallyPaid
definitions.meaning: 対象withdrawalがpaidへ到達

definitions.meaning: decode済み未処理証拠とstrict expiryの照合

definitions.meaning: decode済みmint証拠のfield照合。非0hashの真正性は外部前提

definitions.name: BridgeSpec.MintAuthorization.installSignature
definitions.meaning: 署名時の残り300秒、有限幅、fee一回性を検査する抽象遷移

definitions.meaning: 統合単一recordモデルの会計・quote・lease条件。全runtime安全性ではない
